current_flow: frontend-foundation scaffolds the fresh Next.js (App Router) frontend/ npm workspace and its toolchain (the _ds-token Tailwind theme, locally vendored Inter via next/font/local, in-tree shadcn primitives, a TanStack Query provider) and widens the repo-wide quality gate (build/lint/format/typecheck/test) to the frontend. Input: root workspaces=[contract,backend] + the approved plan + the _ds design tokens. Output: a building, linted, type-checked, hermetically-tested three-workspace repo with a minimal root layout + placeholder page (no app screens). It starts at the workspace/toolchain and stops before any user-facing screen; the shell + OTP login is frontend-shell-login (T8).
new_abstractions: the _ds-token Tailwind theme (--kl-* variables, no raw hex in config)
the next/font/local Inter variable wiring (--font-inter single owner)
the three-workspace quality-gate guard (effective-lint + every-leaf pinning)
the frontend Vitest + RTL + jsdom hermetic runner (offline, frontend-only include)
the orchestrator host-seed provisioning step (exact-pinned deps + provenance-checked font, degraded window)

criteria_map.frontend is a third npm workspace (root: KEEP. Workspace + wrapped root scripts + build:contract-first + build:frontend in root build/structural + non-mutating build (frontend/.gitignore + pre-authored tsconfig, guard-asserted, stage-done rejects churn) are all specified; verified against package.json, tools/quality-gate.test.mjs.
criteria_map.the Tailwind theme is driven entirely by: KEEP. Token def-vs-consumer split with set-level --kl-* parity (D-0005), fonts.css excluded, Inter variable WOFF2 from rsms/inter v4.1 with a pre-declared expected SHA-256, single-owner --font-sans, source-only google-font scan, telemetry-off-in-build, dev:frontend 127.0.0.1:3000; verified against docs/design/.../tokens and the spec local-runtime contract.
criteria_map.root scripts build:frontend, dev:fronten: KEEP. Six *:frontend scripts (build/dev/typecheck/test wrap the workspace; lint/format run root ESLint/Prettier over frontend source globs); FlatCompat bridges eslint-config-next (eslintrc) into the flat root config; verified against eslint.config.mjs and package.json.
criteria_map.a pinned, local, OFFLINE Vitest + React: KEEP. Offline Vitest via npm exec --no, frontend-only test.include (no backend/DB discovery), three attributable JUnit tests with negative controls (0009); JUnit attribution from the required_tests stage-proof commands; test:hermetic in verify_commands; no npm ci in delegated verify.
criteria_map.the repo-wide quality gate is widened to: KEEP. Guard proves the frontend lint is EFFECTIVE (fixture with a known violation), pins every runnable leaf incl. the real build/test bodies, asserts the non-mutating .gitignore/tsconfig; no .prettierignore change (source-scoped globs) so D-0006 is untouched; exact-pinned deps frozen by the lockfile, CI npm ci.

gaps: acceptance_criteria strings were abbreviated vs plan_contracts (task-gate needs exact three-way match)
Vitest command path/cwd was invalid and could discover the backend suite; test:hermetic was not in verify_commands
root build/structural compiled only contract+backend, so CI could green without compiling the frontend
the frontend lint/build/test leaves were not pinned to real bodies (false-green risk)
host provisioning was circular and versions were only major ranges; npm ci needs a network the sandbox lacks
dev:frontend loopback bind (spec local-runtime contract) was omitted; NEXT_TELEMETRY only in .envrc which Actions does not source
the first next build could mutate tracked files (.next/next-env), which stage-done rejects
eslint-config-next 15.1.6 ships eslintrc, not flat, so a flat block is not implementable without a bridge
the widened gate could false-green: no proof a frontend file receives effective rules
'non-mutating build' was only a manual git-status observation, not falsifiable
font provenance was self-attesting (verify against a self-computed hash)
token fidelity was unbounded: 'no hex' vs a source token file that defines hex; no set-level parity
lucide-react was seeded although its first consumer is T8
contradictions: a prior cold read claimed 'vendor-backend-contract still needs reconciliation' — a misread of the frontier (T1-T6 are done; T7 is the planning target)
the _ds fonts.css defines the runtime font via a Google-Fonts @import while the contract forbids external font requests
resolutions: acceptance_criteria set identical to the five plan_contract statements verbatim (criteria==contracts verified at record).
required_tests run from repo root via `npm exec --no -- vitest` (offline, no npx fetch); vitest.config.ts root=repo root with frontend-only test.include; test:hermetic added to verify_commands.
build:frontend added to root `build` so `structural`/FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD compiles all three workspaces; pinned in the guard.
guard pins the six *:frontend bodies (real build w/ build:contract + NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED, real vitest test) and the widened root build/structural/lint/format:check/typecheck/test:hermetic.

orchestrator SEEDS an exact-pinned frontend/package.json + Inter WOFF2 in a degraded window BEFORE delegate and freezes package-lock.json; delegated verify uses the seeded node_modules (no npm ci); npm ci is CI's networked job.
dev:frontend binds 127.0.0.1:3000; NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 set inside the workspace build script (guard-pinned).
build:frontend = `npm run build:contract && npm -w @3f/frontend run build` (workspace dependency-ordering).

frontend/.gitignore ignores .next/next-env.d.ts/*.tsbuildinfo and tsconfig is pre-authored with the Next plugin + .next/types include; the guard asserts these and stage-done rejects tracked-file churn.
eslint.config.mjs wraps eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals into flat config via FlatCompat (@eslint/eslintrc); the frontend reuses the root ESLint (no second pin).
the guard runs ESLint over a frontend/** fixture carrying a known violation and asserts it is reported (proving effective rules).
made falsifiable by the guard (.gitignore + tsconfig assertions) and by stage-done, which rejects any tracked-file change from verification.
the expected SHA-256 is taken from the official immutable rsms/inter v4.1 release and committed as the pin; the seed verifies the downloaded bytes against that pre-declared digest.

definition files legitimately carry the --kl-* hex; the Tailwind config + components consume var(--kl-*) with no hex; a hermetic test asserts set-level parity vs source colors/spacing/typography.css (D-0005) + a negative control.
@3f/contract declared as a MANIFEST-level workspace dependency only (no fabricated import; first real use is frontend-shell-login's api.ts).
lucide-react removed from the seed set; deferred to frontend-shell-login (its first consumer).
verified against .factory/stories/platform-base/stages.json: T1-T6 status done; the frontier is frontend-foundation. No action; noted so it is not re-raised.
fonts.css is a design-reference artifact and is explicitly NOT ported; the runtime font is next/font/local Inter; the hermetic scan targets runtime frontend/ source only, not docs/design.
open_items: ACTION (not a design gap): the Inter WOFF2 host download is a permissioned fetch to be performed at seed time before delegate; the user already chose to vendor Inter locally. Non-blocking for the contract.
